proof_body:
by
  intro n hn
  have he := Real.exp_pos 1
  constructor
  · have h := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (n : ℝ) (by positivity) n
    have hf : (0:ℝ) < n.factorial := by positivity
    rw [div_pow, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hf] at h
    have : Real.exp n = Real.exp 1 ^ n := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; simp
    rw [this] at h
    linarith
  · induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ n hn ih =>
      have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have hkey : Real.exp 1 * (n:ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ ((n:ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
        have hlog : (1:ℝ) / (n + 1) ≤ Real.log (1 + 1 / n) := by
          have := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (x := 1 + 1 / (n:ℝ)) (by positivity)
          have e : 1 - (1 + 1 / (n:ℝ))⁻¹ = 1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) := by field_simp; ring
          linarith
        have h2 : 1 ≤ ((n:ℝ) + 1) * Real.log (1 + 1 / n) := by
          have hp : (0:ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hp] at hlog
          linarith
        have h3 : Real.exp 1 ≤ (1 + 1 / (n:ℝ)) ^ (n + 1) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_log (show (0:ℝ) < (1 + 1 / (n:ℝ)) ^ (n + 1) by positivity), Real.log_pow]
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          push_cast
          exact h2
        have h4 : (1 + 1 / (n:ℝ)) ^ (n + 1) * (n:ℝ) ^ (n + 1) = ((n:ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
          rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; field_simp
        calc Real.exp 1 * (n:ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ (1 + 1 / (n:ℝ)) ^ (n + 1) * (n:ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by gcongr
          _ = _ := h4
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
      push_cast
      have hih : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 * n * ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n := ih
      calc ((n:ℝ) + 1) * (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((n:ℝ) + 1) * (Real.exp 1 * n * ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n) := by gcongr
        _ = ((n:ℝ) + 1) * ((n:ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * Real.exp 1 / Real.exp 1 ^ n) := by
          rw [div_pow, pow_succ]; field_simp
        _ = ((n:ℝ) + 1) * (Real.exp 1 * (n:ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) / Real.exp 1 ^ n := by ring
        _ ≤ ((n:ℝ) + 1) * ((n:ℝ) + 1) ^ (n + 1) / Real.exp 1 ^ n := by gcongr
        _ = Real.exp 1 * ((n:ℝ) + 1) * (((n:ℝ) + 1) / Real.exp 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
          rw [div_pow, pow_succ (Real.exp 1)]; field_simp
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) ∧ (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 * n * ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n
